_what: What this project intends and has not built, for the evidence page. Each item says why it is not built and what it would take. Removed when built, not ticked.

items.what: Production's SSH closed to the internet
items.why: The last client moved to the tailnet path today; the firewall change waits on a snapshot.
items.takes: one firewall rule, a snapshot first

items.why: The house's sensors cannot run a client. Simulated ones would share a cloud host that serves two projects on 2 GB with no swap.
items.takes: a single-board computer and a sensor, about $30

items.what: A mobile unit that takes commands
items.why: The candidate, the house's robot vacuum, cannot run a client; an adapter would need a path into the hub. That is a widening to decide, not a default.
items.takes: a design, then the owner's decision

items.what: Cat-camera visit events in the telemetry stream
items.why: Pushed by the hub like the temperature, never pulled from the camera. Being agreed with the session that manages the house.
items.takes: one more outbound call on the hub, no restart

items.what: The kiosk tablet in a role of its own
items.why: It is a member today, so formally it may do everything an operator may. A role would leave it the dashboard and nothing else.
items.takes: one tag and one grant; the owner's yes

items.what: Lost comms on the household side
items.why: Measured so far only where the lab could break its own link. The hub's link and the control plane are the house's.
items.takes: an agreed window with the household

items.what: A button that starts a check from this page
items.why: A public button needs an endpoint that holds a credential to start a workflow. This page holds none, on purpose.
items.takes: a small cloud function with a capped, audited dispatch

items.why: Two user devices advertise a whole /24 that was never approved, so nothing is routed. Harmless, and a finding.
items.takes: the owners switch the advertisement off

items.what: Just-in-time access to the action tier
items.why: Standing access to the socket would become a grant that expires.
